The Statistics Assistance Center (SAC) offers free drop-in tutoring for STAT 251. No
appointment is needed -- come by during any of the open hours below and a tutor will
be there to help. The SAC is run alongside the Mathematics Assistance Center; see the
[Math Assistance Center page](https://www.uidaho.edu/student-resources/academic-support/math-assistance-center)
for location and additional details.

## SAC Open Hours

| **Day** | **Hours** |
| :--- | :--- |
| Monday | 9:30AM -- 11:30AM, 12:30PM -- 5:00PM |
| Tuesday | 9:30AM -- 3:00PM |
| Wednesday | 9:30AM -- 4:00PM |
| Thursday | 9:30AM -- 3:00PM |
| Friday | 9:30AM -- 12:00PM, 12:30PM -- 2:30PM |

## Our Teaching Assistant's Hours in the SAC

Kyla LaFountain, the teaching assistant for this section, tutors in the SAC during the
hours listed below. These are in addition to the office hours in **Brink Hall, Room
B6/7** (Mondays, 10:00AM -- 12:00PM); see the [syllabus](syllabus.html) for contact
information.

| **Day** | **Hours** |
| :--- | :--- |
| Monday | 2:00PM -- 4:00PM |
| Wednesday | 9:30AM -- 11:00AM |
| Thursday | 12:30PM -- 2:30PM |
| Friday | 9:30AM -- 12:00PM |
